patched_build_note: patched-build cases are judged from data/fixed_releases/<CVE> by vex_judge_v2 --build patched. They require the patch gate: Q1 reads 'present' on 10 of the 12 collected patched trees, because a fix edits the vulnerable function rather than deleting it. So there is no pre-gate patched figure to quote, and 7 of the 9 patched GT cases are patch_verified; --independent is what removes the shared oracle.
